overview:
**High fire danger continues today across the Montrose (High Elevation) zone, driven by warm, dry conditions and elevated energy release (ERC 72%, BI 64%).**
- High danger holds all seven days, with ERC/BI percentiles peaking mid-week (78%) before easing slightly by the weekend as rain chances increase.
- Light NE winds (6–10 mph) and dropping humidity—as low as 21% by Thursday—will keep fuels receptive to ignition.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met, and no Red Flag Warning is in effect for the area today.
- Stage 2 Fire Restrictions are in effect in unincorporated Montrose County, and Gunnison County is in Stage 2 Fire Restrictions as well.
- BLM Stage 1 Fire Restrictions remain in place on public lands within Gunnison, Hinsdale, Montrose, Ouray, Saguache, and San Juan counties.
- The Elk Fire (Hinsdale County, 7 miles NW of Lake City) sits at 7,257 acres and 66% contained, with minimal fire behavior reported and area/road closures still active.
